column1: # Measured wall seconds of one package under `go test` in the go-quality test leg (CHAOS-10355), the weight ci/go_race_shard.awk balances the test shards by
# (`check_go.sh ci-leg test K N`). Re-measured for CHAOS-13422: MEDIAN (rounded to whole seconds) of the uncached `ok <pkg> <n>s` lines of the test legs of the last 10 successful
# Rows: every package of median >= 20 s, every package that already had a row (a row of a package with no uncached line in those runs keeps its earlier value), and the packages the

# unweighted-slow guard flagged on a starved shard (internal/auth/identity/saml, internal/cigates/bigboyrender, internal/auth/identity; their median here, CHAOS-13422). A package with no row weighs 1.
# The weights only need to be roughly right: a wrong one costs balance, never coverage (the shards always partition `go list ./...`). Key = import path relative to the module root.
# Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates; internal/cigates/testshard checks each row names a real package.
